name: kitted-firebase-tests
description: Rules and server-job checks R1-R10, F1-F3, the AI proxy's P/L/M/D (handoff/13-server.md §7), the sync adapters X1-X8 (handoff/11-firestore-schema.md §9, §11) on the Firebase emulator (dev-only; Java from the Mac). Run from firebase/: npm --prefix tests run emulate

scripts.emulate: cd .. && tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kitted --only firestore,storage,auth 'npm --prefix tests test'
scripts.smoke: cd .. && npm --prefix functions run build && printf 'GEMINI_KEY=smoke-key-123\n' > functions/.secret.local && printf 'GEMINI_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:9877\n' > functions/.env.local && tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kitted --only firestore,auth,functions 'node tests/smoke.mjs' < /dev/null; rm -f functions/.secret.local functions/.env.local
scripts.appserve: cd .. && npm --prefix functions run build && printf 'GEMINI_KEY=appserve-key-123\n' > functions/.secret.local && printf 'GEMINI_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:9877\n' > functions/.env.local && tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kitted --only firestore,auth,functions 'node tests/appserve.mjs' < /dev/null; rm -f functions/.secret.local functions/.env.local
